test.title: A trip you are planning to take

document.cue: Describe a trip you are planning to take.

text: The trip I'm planning at the moment is a week in Uzbekistan next spring, probably in April, when it's warm but not too hot yet. I'm going with my father, which will be the first time the two of us have travelled together without the rest of the family.

The plan is to fly to Tashkent, spend a day there, and then take the high-speed train to Samarkand and Bukhara. My dad is in charge of the budget and I'm in charge of the route, which already caused a small argument about whether we really need three days in Bukhara.

In Samarkand, I mostly want to see the Registan, the famous square surrounded by three huge madrasas covered in blue tiles. I've seen photos of it so many times that I'm curious whether it will feel as impressive in real life. My dad, on the other hand, is mainly excited about the food — he's already talking about trying plov in every city and comparing it with my mother's.

The main reason I want to go is that Uzbekistan is so close to us culturally, yet I know surprisingly little about its history. And honestly, I think it's a good chance to spend time with my dad, because since I started university we mostly talk on the phone.
So I'm hoping it'll be both an interesting trip and a bit of a family adventure.

tips.en: I'm going with, the plan is to and will show a range of future forms.
tips.kk: I'm going with, the plan is to, will — келер шақ формаларының алуан түрлілігі.
tips.ru: I'm going with, the plan is to, will — разнообразие форм будущего.

tips.en: The argument about Bukhara and the plov comparison make the story lively.
tips.kk: Бұхарадағы үш күн туралы дау және «анамдікіндей» палау әңгімені жандандырады.
tips.ru: Спор про три дня в Бухаре и плов «как у мамы» оживляют рассказ.

note.en: “But I know much less than expected”.
note.ru: «И всё же я удивительно мало знаю».

note.en: Where, when and who with — straight away, with a weather detail.
note.kk: Қайда, қашан және кіммен — бірден, ауа райы туралы дерекпен.
note.ru: Куда, когда и с кем — сразу, с деталью про погоду.

note.en: The route and who does what — with light humour.
note.kk: Бағыт және кім неге жауапты — жеңіл әзілмен.
note.ru: Маршрут и кто за что отвечает — с лёгким юмором.

note.en: “What we will do” — each person has their own interest.
note.ru: «Что будем делать» — у каждого свой интерес.

note.en: Why there — cultural closeness and time with the father.
note.kk: Неге сонда — мәдени жақындық және әкемен уақыт.
note.ru: Почему туда — культурная близость и время с отцом.

note.en: A short summary of the trip's two purposes.
note.kk: Сапардың екі мақсаты туралы қысқа қорытынды.
note.ru: Короткий итог о двойной цели поездки.
